```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Gallatin' AND addr_state ILIKE 'Texas'
)
, slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM region_geom), TRUE),
      1,
      '32BF'
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM region_geom))
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(value), 2) AS avg_slope_degrees
FROM (
  SELECT
    (ST_SummaryStats(slope_rast, TRUE)).*
  FROM slope_raster
) AS stats;
```
